messages:
tara_logistics: Heads up — AWB 123-4567890 is stuck at EU customs for HS classification. Forwarded from vendor: reported minor foam crush and a serial mismatch on 5/10. PO RWF-2026-77. Can vendor confirm replacements and ETA? We need at least 4 H100s routed to cover redwood-dedicated-1 pool; buffer is nearly exhausted.

ivan_vendor: Really sorry about the disruption. We ran a quick crossdock inspection — one pallet showed foam damage, two units flagged for serial mismatch. I've opened RMA case VC-8811. I can hold 6 units for expedite if you want air express. Photos here: https://files.vendor-share.example/VC-8811-photos 

alex_ops: Noted. Cluster impact: dedicated pool redwood-dedicated-1 is operating at 92% utilization; queue length increased and tail p50->p95 latencies spiking ~18% since 09:20 UTC. If we don't top off, we may hit SLO breaches for some customers. Suggest draining 4 nodes in the evening window for swap.

jamie_sre: Can someone paste the serials affected? I need them to reconcile with inventory and to prepare return labels. If vendor can do partial ship (3 now, 3 later) that helps. Also confirm whether replacements are zero-hour rebrand or new SKUs — affects inventory mapping.

sophie_finance: Quick cost check: air express per H100 to NA is ~€1,200/unit, customs broker ~€300 shipment, insurance optional (~€150/shipment). If vendor covers freight for DOA, ok; otherwise we need PO approval. Please confirm who signs for expedite.

ivan_vendor: Serial list attached in the photo bundle. Replacements are new units (fresh SKUs), not refurbished. Plan we can do: ship 3 via air express today if you authorize expedite charge, ship remaining 3 next-day or hold until customs clear for consolidated pickup. AWBs will be provided by EOD. Customs HS code will be 8471.80.90 (IT machines). Re-labeling to 'IT hardware - not for resale' can be done but adds ~24h.

tara_logistics: Approve 3-unit air express now. Hold the rest for consolidated ship unless customs clears in 48h. Please upload AWB numbers and scanned commercial invoice. Also need CSV mapping of old_serial -> new_serial and RMA tag. Example: ```old_serial,new_serial,rma_case
SN-H100-001,SN-H100-101,VC-8811
SN-H100-005,SN-H100-105,VC-8811```

rma-bot: RMA case VC-8811 opened and assigned to tara_logistics. Status: vendor confirmation pending.

alex_ops: We'll schedule node drain for 4 nodes at 22:00 UTC tonight to apply swaps and avoid rolling impact. Please ensure shipments land before 22:00 + 48h for manual swap window; if late we may apply temporary autoscale limits.

jamie_sre: Once AWBs are posted I’ll reconcile inventory and create inbound receiving tickets (`WH-IN-7621`). Provide any customs broker contact details if you want us to coordinate clearance.

ivan_vendor: AWBs posted: EU->US partial: AWB123456789 (3 units), AWB123456790 (3 units). ETA to US hub: 48 hours after pickup. Commercial invoice uploaded here: https://files.vendor-share.example/VC-8811-invoice. We'll mark shipments with HS 8471 and add 'IT hardware - not for resale' on request. Invoice for expedite will be submitted under PO RWF-2026-77.

tara_logistics: Perfect — thanks. Proceed with the 3-unit air express. Sophie, please approve expedite cost to charge to RWF-2026-77 so vendor can bill. Jamie/alex — I’ll ping again once AWB clears. :thumbsup:

sophie_finance: Approved up to €4k for this expedite under RWF-2026-77. Vendor, send invoice and we’ll route payment.

ivan_vendor: Thanks, will send invoice and tracking updates as shipments progress. Will also attach photos of packed units and the old->new serial CSV.

tara_logistics: Copy — closing action items: vendor to post AWB + invoice, vendor to upload old->new serial CSV, ops to drain nodes at 22:00 UTC, SRE to reconcile on receipt. Keep channel updated.
